title: Enhancement: better search options - eg Location
body:
Hi, would love to be able to search for players that are in a particular part of the world. People who live in the city nearest to me OR imagine I was planning to travel to a city, I could potentially meet some players online on lichess months before leaving and then meet them for a game or three in person.... could this be done by world town, city or other geo-location method?

Thanks to all
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: How would that work? Lichess doesn't know where players live. In many cases it maybe can be roughly determined by IPs but exposing that to users seems like a massive privacy laws violation.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: Team search can be found at https://lichess.org/team/all and teams exist about major cities,

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: It could work with info from user profiles - the town/city field for example. Lichess could prompt users to fill this in when they join and then occasionally, so others know where they are, etc. Otherwise from IP address... anyone actually worried about privacy would be using a VPN or similar to hide it...

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
